{
  "findings": [
    {
      "type": "TEMPORAL",
      "note_section": "History",
      "note_span": "Episode about three months ago after skipping lunch while gardening:",
      "transcript_evidence": "Wednesday. No, it was Tuesday, because it was bin day and I'd just put them out.",
      "evidence_turns": [
        7
      ],
      "severity": 1,
      "likelihood": 1,
      "rationale": "The note fails to record the specific day (Tuesday) and context (bin day) of the hypoglycaemic episode mentioned in the transcript."
    },
    {
      "type": "PLAN_CHANGE",
      "note_section": "Plan",
      "note_span": "Continue gliclazide 80 mg twice daily.",
      "transcript_evidence": "I'd like to reduce it to 80 milligrams in the morning only, and stop the teatime dose.",
      "evidence_turns": [
        42
      ],
      "severity": 3,
      "likelihood": 4,
      "rationale": "The plan contradicts the clinician's suggested dose reduction for gliclazide found in the transcript."
    },
    {
      "type": "LATERALITY",
      "note_section": "Examination",
      "note_span": "Callus under the right first metatarsal head.",
      "transcript_evidence": "There's a bit of hard skin, a callus, under the ball of your left foot, by the big toe.",
      "evidence_turns": [
        38
      ],
      "severity": 2,
      "likelihood": 2,
      "rationale": "The note incorrectly documents the location of the callus as the right foot instead of the left foot."
    },
    {
      "type": "SAFETY_NETTING",
      "note_section": "Safety-netting",
      "note_span": "Severe hypo (needed help from someone else): if another within 12 months, or any hypo while driving, stop driving and inform the DVLA.",
      "transcript_evidence": "And because you needed your daughter's help, that counts as a severe hypo.",
      "evidence_turns": [
        46
      ],
      "severity": 3,
      "likelihood": 4,
      "rationale": "The note omits the critical safety fact that the need for assistance from someone else (the daughter) constitutes a severe hypoglycaemic event."
    }
  ],
  "overall_note_safety": "needs_major_edits"
}
